final_formulations.manufacturing_process: Stage 1: Rehydrate plant-dairy base and disperse protein isolates under high-shear mixing. | Stage 2: Hydrate hydrocolloid texturizers (pectin/starch) and pasteurize matrix (85-90°C for 5 minutes). | Stage 3: Cool to 42°C, inoculate bio-fermentation starter culture, and incubate to target pH 4.4 - 4.6. | Stage 4: Gentle break agitation, blend fruit/flavor preparation, and aseptic fill into chilled storage.

final_formulations.manufacturing_process: Stage 1: Rehydrate plant-dairy base and disperse protein isolates under high-shear mixing. | Stage 2: Hydrate hydrocolloid texturizers (pectin/starch) and pasteurize matrix (85-90°C for 5 minutes). | Stage 3: Cool to 42°C, inoculate bio-fermentation starter culture, and incubate to target pH 4.4 - 4.6. | Stage 4: Gentle break agitation, blend fruit/flavor preparation, and aseptic fill into chilled storage.
